overview: Equipment Permit-to-Work Assurance addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in oil, gas and petrochemicals operations. The first proof of value uses permit forms, isolation lists and shift handovers. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is overdue high-risk work permits, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: permit forms, isolation lists and shift handovers; define overdue high-risk work permits and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Asset Integrity Director / Production Manager.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
